## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the issue, the change and any user-visible limitations.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] Types pass (`npm run typecheck`).
- [ ] Production build passes (`npm run build`).
- [ ] Staged files pass `npm run check:publication`.
- [ ] Regression coverage or a reason it is unnecessary is included.

Use synthetic data in examples and screenshots. Do not include credentials, captured activity or private repository contents.
